exposure: SNPs in genes encoding angiogenesis-related factors
cohort: The study included 247 women who had undergone ART procedures (infertile women) and 120 healthy controls.
finding: The KDR gene rs2071559 variant was associated with an increased risk of infertility, and the VEGFA rs699947 variant was associated with an increased risk of recurrent implantation failures in infertile ART-treated Polish women.
